evidence: Matches the 'Block storage' maintainer label and directly modifies block file management under src/node/blockstorage.
rationale: Acquiring an exclusive lock directly in BlockManager prevents silent block file corruption when kernel tools access an active node's blocks directory. As the PR notes, previously 'only bitcoind locked the blocks directory during initialization, while the kernel did no directory locking', allowing secondary processes to 'silently overwrite existing block files from offset 0, corrupting the running node's data.' Fixing this closes a significant data integrity hazard as libbitcoinkernel adoption progresses.
